title: Measuring the Depth of Safety Alignment: A Formal Token-Budget Test

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifies the shallow alignment phenomenon precisely. Mapping the depth curve is a first step toward understanding alignment robustness. Direct implications for whether current alignment methods provide meaningful guarantees.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Forced prefix generation is well-documented. Uses standard open models via HuggingFace. Needs a harmful-prompt benchmark (existing ones available). Token forcing is a simple modification. Highly accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment: force prefixes of varying length, measure refusal rate. Two models, four prefix lengths. Clear deliverable: refusal rate vs. prefix length curve. Very focused and completable within 30 hours.
